name: What is the installation process for a new water feature?

mainEntity.name: What is the installation process for a new water feature?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation process typically begins with a consultation and site assessment to understand your vision and evaluate the landscape. This leads to a design proposal, including layout, materials, and cost estimates. Once approved, the construction phase involves excavation, plumbing, electrical wiring, liner installation (for ponds/streams), rock placement, and integration of pumps and filters. Finally, the system is tested, and aesthetic elements like lighting and landscaping are added. Our team manages all stages, ensuring a seamless transition from design to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation involves consultation, design, site preparation, construction of the feature, plumbing, electrical, and final landscaping. We manage all stages.
